name: eclipses
comment: Geometry test blob: Sun, Earth, and Moon for 16 days that hold the partial solar eclipse of 2004-10-14 and the total lunar eclipse of 2004-10-28, for the sub-point and occultation tests. The kernels carry no ephemeris for a triaxial body, so the Mars barycenter (4) stands in for one: it is given the radii and the IAU orientation of Phobos. Body -900 is a spacecraft with no trajectory; the tests place it with a supplied state.
